Export.zv: IRIS for UNIX (Ubuntu Server LTS for ARM64 Containers) 2026.1 (Build 234U)

Class.name: %IPM.Repo.Oras.HttpException
Class.Description: A failed response from an ORAS registry, built from the helper's RegistryHttpError. Classify sets the message a user sees.

Property.name: RegistryMessage
Property.Description: The registry's own message from the response body, if any.

Property.name: CredentialsRejected
Property.Description: Set by Classify when the registry rejected the configured credentials.

Method.name: FromException
Method.Description: Returns ex as an HttpException if it is one or is a RegistryHttpError raised by the oras helper, otherwise "".

Method.name: IsRegistryFailure
Method.Description: Returns whether ex is a failed registry response.

Method.name: Classify
Method.Description: Sets Text and CredentialsRejected for this failure on module moduleName in repo repoName at repoURL. probe is the result of %IPM.Repo.Oras.PackageService:ProbeCredentials, used for a 401 or 403 when hasCredentials is set.

Method.name: OnAsStatus
